page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Notes in the right margin: "4. Divisio" beside the second paragraph's first line, and "5 Impe-rii de-clinatio" beside the line "po-tentia". Running head centred above the text. Page number top right. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: diaOrientali Abysiniam detexerunt: & quanquam jam A.C. 1400 Zarah Jacob, Rex Abysinorum, Legatos suos Romam ad Papam Eugenium IV misisset, tum tamen nihil adhuc certi de rebus Imperii innotuit, & Europæis usq; ad Lusitanorum ad-ventum inaccessa mansit. Abeo tem-pore, quò Lusitani Indiam Orientalem frequentarunt exactius omnia explorata; sed initia multis figmentis contaminata sunt; cum ipsi Aby-sini felicitatem & potentiam suam immane quantum extollerent men-daciter, ut innumera mendacia de A-bysinorum rebus vulgò spargeren-tur.
main_text.head: Explicatio 2.
main_text.p: Quæ autem certò cognita sunt4. Divi-sio ab A.C. 1560 ita se habent: Abysi-nium Imperium olim 16 Regna, in 14 distributa Regiones, complectebatur: sed ita decrevit antiqua illa po-5 Impe-rii de-clinatiotentia & majestas, ut hodie non nisi 4.

page.notes: The left edge shows fragments of the facing page's text and is left out. Faint show-through at the right edge is left out. The line "po-tentia" is printed without a hyphen at its end, so "potentia" is written whole. The marginal note "5 Impe-rii de-clinatio" is set beside the same line as the word "potentia" and is placed there. Long s is written as plain s throughout.
